name: Joshua
description: High Priest living at the time of Exile and Return

points: The first wave came led by Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, and the other chief men. Zerubbabel had been one of the bodyguards of the Persian Empire, the wisest guard granted a request in 1 Esdras.

note.label: Ezra 2: The Register of Those Who Returned

points: Jeshua and Zerubbabel build the altar of the God of Israel to offer burnt offerings as written in the law of Moses.

note.label: Ezra 3: The Foundation of the Temple Is Laid

points: In the second year of their coming, Zerubbabel and Jeshua and the remnant of their brethren the priests and Levites appoint the Levites from twenty years old and upward to set forward the work.

note.label: Ezra 3: The Foundation of the Temple Is Laid

points: But Zerubbabel, and Jeshua, and the rest of the chief of the fathers of Israel, said unto them, Ye have nothing to do with us. What did they say unto them? You have what? Ye have nothing to do with us. That is like when I did the interview: can white people come join you all? No. No, they cannot join us. That simple. They were mad as hell. So can white people join? I am saying, you are saying all this, but can — no, no, no. Sorry. And they were mad. But that is what it is. That is what our forefathers did.

note.label: Unity: The Sweet Savor Of Salvation

points: Zerubbabel and Jeshua answered, Ye have nothing to do with us to build an house unto our God; but we ourselves together will build. Then the people of the land weakened the hands of the people of Judah, and troubled them in building, and hired counsellors against them to frustrate their purpose.

note.label: Recovering the Remnant: Worldwide Blitz

points: Zerubbabel, Jeshua, and the chief of the fathers refuse them: the strangers have nothing to do with building the house of the God of Israel.

note.label: Ezra 4: The Adversaries Halt the Building

points: After the work had been hindered for roughly two years, the prophets Haggai and Zechariah stirred up the leaders, and Zerubbabel and Jeshua rose again to build the house of God.

note.label: Ezra 5: The Prophets Rise Up To Build

points: These are the priests and Levites that went up with Zerubbabel and Jeshua: Seraiah, Jeremiah, Ezra, and the rest named as the chiefs of the priests and their brethren in the days of Jeshua.

note.label: Nehemiah 12: The Priests, the Levites, and the Dedication of the Wall

points: The priestly succession is traced: Jeshua begat Joiakim, Joiakim begat Eliashib, and the line continues through Joiada, Jonathan, and Jaddua.

note.label: Nehemiah 12: The Priests, the Levites, and the Dedication of the Wall

points: In the second year of Darius the king came the word of the Lord by Haggai the prophet unto Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua the son of Josedech, the high priest.

note.label: We Are Born in Babylon

points: In the second year of Darius the king, in the sixth month, in the first day of the month, came the word of the Lord by Haggai the prophet unto Zerubbabel the governor of Judah, and to Joshua the high priest.

note.label: Haggai 1: Consider Your Ways

points: Then Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Joshua the son of Josedech the high priest, with all the remnant of the people, obeyed the voice of the Lord their God, and the words of Haggai the prophet, and the people did fear before the Lord.

Notice: Joshua was the high priest, Zerubbabel was the governor; Haggai was not in those positions. But Joshua and Zerubbabel humbled themselves, because they knew it was the word of the Lord; they knew Haggai and Zechariah were sent of God. Zerubbabel could have said, arrest him, lock him up; or he could have punched a hole in his chest. He did none of that. He said, I recognize the word of the Lord; I am going to humble myself.

note.label: We Are Born in Babylon

points: Then spake Haggai the Lord's messenger in the Lord's message unto the people, saying, I am with you, saith the Lord. And the Lord stirred up the spirit of Zerubbabel, and the spirit of Joshua, and the spirit of all the remnant of the people; and they came and did work in the house of the Lord of hosts, their God.

note.label: We Are Born in Babylon

points: The word comes to Zerubbabel the governor of Judah, to Joshua the high priest, and to the residue of the people.

note.label: Haggai 2: The Glory of the Latter House

points: Yet now be strong, O Zerubbabel, saith the Lord; and be strong, O Joshua, son of Josedech, the high priest; and be strong, all ye people of the land, saith the Lord, and work: for I am with you, saith the Lord of hosts.

note.label: We Are Born in Babylon

points: He shewed me Joshua the high priest standing before the angel of the Lord, and Satan standing at his right hand to resist him.

note.label: Zechariah 3: The Filthy Garments Taken Away

points: Joshua was clothed with filthy garments, and stood before the angel. Take away the filthy garments from him.

note.label: Zechariah 3: The Filthy Garments Taken Away

points: Behold, I will bring forth my servant the Branch, and the stone laid before Joshua with seven eyes; the Branch and the stone are Christ.

note.label: The Nativity: the Bloodline, Birthright, & the Messiah

points: During the Persian captivity you had Joshua the high priest, of the tribe of Levi, and Zerubbabel the governor, of the tribe of Judah.
Hear now, O Joshua the high priest, thou, and thy fellows that sit before thee: for they are men wondered at: for, behold, I will bring forth my servant the BRANCH. The Branch is Christ.

note.label: We Are Born in Babylon

points: Hear now, O Joshua the high priest, thou, and thy fellows that sit before thee: for they are men wondered at; for behold, I will bring forth my servant the BRANCH. That is the remnant of Israel, Judah and Benjamin and Levi.

note.label: Zechariah 3: The Filthy Garments Taken Away

points: For behold the stone that I have laid before Joshua; upon one stone shall be seven eyes: those are the angels. And I will remove the iniquity of that land in one day: that is Christ dying on the cross.

note.label: We Are Born in Babylon

points: Behold the stone that I have laid before Joshua; upon one stone shall be seven eyes: and I will remove the iniquity of that land in one day.

note.label: Zechariah 3: The Filthy Garments Taken Away

points: Take silver and gold, and make crowns, and set them upon the head of Joshua the son of Josedech, the high priest.

note.label: Zechariah 6: The Four Chariots and the Crowning of Joshua
